subject: Update valkey-benchmark parseURI function name and comment (#1845)
reason: The change renames parseRedisUri to parseUri and updates a comment; the URI parsing logic is byte-for-byte unchanged and all four schemes (valkey://, valkeys://, redis://, rediss://) were already accepted before the change. The only observable difference is the tool_name string in valkey-benchmark's error message ('redis-benchmark' -> 'valkey-benchmark'), which is printed only when a TLS URI is passed to a binary compiled without OpenSSL and is UNUSED dead data on TLS-enabled builds. A compared tools run asserting that message would fail as unreached on any OpenSSL build, and the delta itself
